# GDP Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(slider)
library(stringr)
library(this.path)
# knitr resets the working directory after every chunk, so setwd() alone only
# lasts for this chunk. root.dir makes it apply to the whole document.
data_dir <- paste0(dirname(this.dir()),"/Data/IHME_covs")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = data_dir)
setwd(data_dir)

GDP_wide_dat <- read_xls("API_NY.GDP.PCAP.KD.ZG_DS2_en_excel_v2_51.xls")

GDP_dat <- GDP_wide_dat |>  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `1960`:`2025`,
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "GDP") |>
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year)
  ) |> 
  rename(
    country = country_name
  ) |> 
  select(-c("indicator_name", "indicator_code")) |> 
  filter(
    year > 1989
  )

# GDP per capita growth (annual %) is `gdp`. The GDP per capita level (current US$)
# is read below as `gdp_pc` (World Bank NY.GDP.PCAP.CD).
GDP_pc_dat <- read_csv("API_NY.GDP.PCAP.CD_DS2_en_csv_v2_468810.csv",
                       show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(`Country Code`, matches("^[0-9]{4}$")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -`Country Code`,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "gdp_pc") |>
  rename(country_code = `Country Code`) |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |>
  filter(year > 1989)

# The level must be positive (it is log-transformed in the imputation)
stopifnot(all(GDP_pc_dat$gdp_pc > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

GDP_dat <- GDP_dat |>
  left_join(GDP_pc_dat, by = c("country_code", "year"))

# Share of rows with each GDP measure
GDP_dat |> summarise(across(c(gdp, gdp_pc), \(x) mean(!is.na(x))))
```

# Immunization

DPT immunization (% of children ages 12-23 months, `SH.IMM.IDPT`) from the World Bank, a measure of health system access. The file (`Immun_skilled_WB_data_Oct26.csv`) is in long format (one row per series and country) and also has births attended by skilled health staff (`SH.STA.BRTC.ZS`), which is not used because it is observed for too few country-years.

```{r}
imm_dat <- read_csv("Immun_skilled_WB_data_Oct26.csv",
                            col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  # drops the footnote rows at the end of the World Bank file
  filter(!is.na(`Series Code`)) |>
  select(series = `Series Code`, country_code = `Country Code`,
         matches("^[0-9]{4} ")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(series, country_code),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(substr(year, 1, 4)),
    value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
  ) |>
  filter(year > 1989) |>
  filter(series == "SH.IMM.IDPT") |>
  select(country_code, year, dpt_imm = value)

# Percentages
stopifnot(all(imm_dat$dpt_imm >= 0 & imm_dat$dpt_imm <= 100, na.rm = TRUE),
          !anyDuplicated(imm_dat[, c("country_code", "year")]))

GDP_dat <- GDP_dat |>
  left_join(imm_dat, by = c("country_code", "year"))

# Share of rows observed, by year
GDP_dat |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(across(dpt_imm, \(x) round(mean(!is.na(x)), 2))) |>
  print(n = 40)
```


# Consumer Price Indices


```{r}
wide_fpi <- read_csv("ConsumerPriceIndices_E_All_Data.csv")

wide_fpi <- wide_fpi |> 
  select(!ends_with("F"))|> 
  select(!ends_with("N"))

long_wide_fpi_month_yr <- wide_fpi |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = "Y2000":"Y2026",
    names_to = "year",
    names_pattern = "Y(.*)",
    values_to = "FPI"
  ) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  rename(
    country = area
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year)
  ) |> 
  select(-c(item_code:months_code, unit))  

long_wide_fpi_yr  <- long_wide_fpi_month_yr |> 
  filter(!is.na(fpi)) |>
  group_by(area_code, area_code_m49, country, year) |> 
  summarise(
    fpi_avg = mean(fpi, na.rm = TRUE),    
    fpi_max = max(fpi, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.nan(fpi_avg)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    fpi_prev5yr_avg = slide_dbl(
      fpi_avg,
      mean,
      .before = 5,
      .after = -1,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    fpi_anom = fpi_avg - fpi_prev5yr_avg
  ) |> 
  ungroup()
```

Normalized version, just to see if it matches.

```{r}
fpi_long <- read_csv("ConsumerPriceIndices_E_All_Data_(Normalized).csv") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  rename(
    country = area,
  ) |> 
  select(-c(item_code:months_code, unit, flag, note, year_code)) 

long_fpi_yr  <- fpi_long |> 
  filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  group_by(area_code, area_code_m49, country, year) |> 
  summarise(
    fpi_avg = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),    
    fpi_max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.nan(fpi_avg)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    fpi_prev5yr_avg = slide_dbl(
      fpi_avg,
      mean,
      .before = 5,
      .after = -1,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    fpi_anom = fpi_avg - fpi_prev5yr_avg
  ) |> 
  ungroup()
```

Check for differences:

```{r}
diff <- long_fpi_yr |> 
  left_join(
    long_wide_fpi_yr, 
    by = c("area_code", "area_code_m49", "country", "year")
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    diff = fpi_avg.x - fpi_avg.y,
    same = fpi_avg.x == fpi_avg.y
  )
summary(diff$diff)

```

There are none.

```{r}
head(long_fpi_yr)
```

```{r}

country_data <- read_excel("Country_connectors.xlsx") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  select(country_or_area,m49_code,iso_alpha3_code)

long_fpi_yr <- long_fpi_yr |> 
  mutate(
    area_code_m49 = str_remove(area_code_m49, "^'") |> as.numeric()
  )

# This is a clean merge
long_fpi_yr |> 
  anti_join(
    country_data, by = c("area_code_m49"= "m49_code")
  )

fpi_w_country <- long_fpi_yr |> 
  left_join(
    country_data, by = c("area_code_m49"= "m49_code")
  )

## Areas in GDP data don't merge and will be dropped:
no_match <- GDP_dat |> 
   anti_join(
     country_data, by = c("country_code" = "iso_alpha3_code")
   ) |> 
  distinct(country)

no_match$country

gdp_w_country <- GDP_dat |> 
  left_join(
    country_data, by = c("country_code" = "iso_alpha3_code")
  ) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(m49_code)
  )


gdp_w_country <- gdp_w_country |>
  bind_rows(
    gdp_w_country |>
      filter(year == 2025) |>
      mutate(year = 2026, 
             gdp = NA_real_,
             gdp_pc = NA_real_,
             dpt_imm = NA_real_)
  ) |> 
  arrange(country, year)
```

Now we'll merge the FPI with the GDP data:

```{r}
# For some countries, GDP is missing. Overall, GDP has more years.

fpi_gdp <- gdp_w_country |> 
  full_join(fpi_w_country,
            by = c("m49_code" = "area_code_m49", "year")) |> 
  select(-c(area_code, country_or_area.y,iso_alpha3_code)) |> 
  rename(
    country_or_area = country_or_area.x) |> 
  select(
    country.x, country_or_area, country.y, country_code, m49_code, everything()
  ) |>
  arrange(m49_code, year) |>
  group_by(m49_code) |>
  fill(country.y, .direction = "downup") |>
  ungroup()

```

# IHME Data 

```{r}
shock_data <- read_excel("IHME_GBD_2023_COV_1980_2023_MX_SHOCK_LAST_10YEARS_Y2025M01D08.xlsx") |> 
  clean_names() |>
  filter(age_group_id == 22 & sex == "Both") |> 
  rename(
    shock = mean_value,
    year = year_id
         ) |> 
  select(location_id, location_name, year, shock)
war_terror_data <- read_excel("IHME_GBD_2023_COV_1980_2023_MX_WARTERROR_10YEARS_Y2025M01D08.xlsx") |> 
  clean_names() |>
  filter(age_group_id == 22 & sex == "Both") |> 
  rename(
    war_terror = mean_value,
    year = year_id
         ) |> 
  select(location_id, location_name, year, war_terror)

location_data <- read_excel("GBD_2021_GBD_LOCATION_HIERARCHY_Y2024M05D16.xlsx") |> 
  clean_names() 

shock_data |> 
  anti_join(war_terror_data)

war_terror_data |> 
  anti_join(shock_data)

# Join the location hierarchy on location_id only: the IHME covariate files
# store some names with broken encoding ("CÃ´te d'Ivoire", "TÃ¼rkiye") and
# "Taiwan" vs "Taiwan (Province of China)", so joining on location_name as well
# dropped those countries at the level == 3 filter.
shock_war <- shock_data |>
  left_join(war_terror_data, by = c("location_id", "year")) |>
  select(-location_name.y) |>
  rename(location_name = location_name.x) |>
  left_join(location_data |> select(-location_name), by = "location_id") |>
  filter(level == 3)
```

# Merging IHME with FPI and GDP data



```{r}
gbd_country <- location_data |> 
  filter(level == 3)|>
  mutate(gbd_location_name = location_name)
no_match <- gbd_country |>
  distinct(location_name) |>
  mutate(
    match_country_x = location_name %in% fpi_gdp$country.x,
    match_country_or_area = location_name %in% fpi_gdp$country_or_area,
    match_country_y = location_name %in% fpi_gdp$country.y
  ) |>
  filter(
    !match_country_x &
    !match_country_or_area &
    !match_country_y
  ) |>
  arrange(location_name)

no_match
```


```{r}
# 1. First try country_or_area
fpi_gdp_ihme <- fpi_gdp |>
  full_join(
    gbd_country,
    by = c("country_or_area" = "location_name")
  )

# 2. Fill remaining location IDs using country.x
lookup_countryx <- fpi_gdp_ihme |>
  filter(is.na(location_id)) |>
  select(country.x) |>
  distinct() |>
  left_join(
    gbd_country,
    by = c("country.x" = "location_name")
  ) 

fpi_gdp_ihme <- fpi_gdp_ihme |>
  left_join(
    lookup_countryx,
    by = "country.x",
    suffix = c("", ".countryx")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    location_id = coalesce(location_id, location_id.countryx),
    parent_id = coalesce(parent_id, parent_id.countryx),
    level = coalesce(level, level.countryx),
    sort_order = coalesce(sort_order, sort_order.countryx),
    location_set_version_id =
      coalesce(location_set_version_id,
               location_set_version_id.countryx)
  ) |>
  select(-ends_with(".countryx"))

# 3. Finally try country.y
lookup_countryy <- fpi_gdp_ihme |>
  filter(is.na(location_id)) |>
  select(country.y) |>
  distinct() |>
  left_join(
    gbd_country,
    by = c("country.y" = "location_name")
  )

fpi_gdp_ihme <- fpi_gdp_ihme |>
  left_join(
    lookup_countryy,
    by = "country.y",
    suffix = c("", ".countryy")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    location_id = coalesce(location_id, location_id.countryy),
    parent_id = coalesce(parent_id, parent_id.countryy),
    level = coalesce(level, level.countryy),
    sort_order = coalesce(sort_order, sort_order.countryy),
    location_set_version_id =
      coalesce(location_set_version_id,
               location_set_version_id.countryy)
  ) |>
  select(-ends_with(".countryy"))
```

## What didn't merge?

Rows in your GDP/FPI data could not be linked to a GBD country.

```{r}
fpi_gdp_ihme |>
  filter(is.na(location_id)) |>
  distinct(country.x, country_or_area, country.y)
```

Which GBD countries have no GDP/FPI data?

```{r}
fpi_gdp_ihme |>
  filter(is.na(year)) |>
  select(gbd_location_name, location_id)
```

Did any countries match more than once?

```{r}
fpi_gdp_ihme |>
  distinct(location_id, country_or_area) |>
  count(location_id) |>
  filter(n > 1)
```


```{r}
fpi_gdp_ihme |>
  filter(is.na(location_id)) |>
  distinct(country.x, country_or_area, country.y) |>
  arrange(country_or_area) |> print(n = 23)
```

Fix those with different names:

```{r}
fpi_gdp <- fpi_gdp |>
  mutate(
    country_or_area = recode(
      country_or_area,
      "State of Palestine" = "Palestine",
      "Netherlands (Kingdom of the)" = "Netherlands",
      "United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland" = "United Kingdom",
      "Côte d’Ivoire" = "Côte d'Ivoire",
      "China, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" = "Hong Kong SAR, China",
      "China, Macao Special Administrative Region" = "Macao SAR, China",
      "Saint Martin (French Part)" = "St. Martin (French part)"
    )
  )
```


Remerge:

```{r}

fpi_gdp_ihme <- fpi_gdp |>

    by = c("country.x" = "location_name")

fpi_gdp_ihme <- fpi_gdp_ihme |>

    suffix = c("", ".countryx")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    location_id = coalesce(location_id, location_id.countryx),

    level = coalesce(level, level.countryx),
    sort_order = coalesce(sort_order, sort_order.countryx),

# 3. Finally try country.y
lookup_countryy <- fpi_gdp_ihme |>
```

## Finally, merge IHME and FPI/GDP data


```{r}
crosswalk <- gbd_country |>
  transmute(
    location_id,
    gbd_location_name,
    level
  ) |>
  left_join(
    fpi_gdp |>
      distinct(country_or_area, country_code, m49_code),
    by = c("gbd_location_name" = "country_or_area")
  )

crosswalk <- crosswalk |>
  mutate(
    country_code = case_when(
      gbd_location_name == "Taiwan (Province of China)" ~ "TWN",
      TRUE ~ country_code
    ),
    m49_code = case_when(
      gbd_location_name == "Taiwan (Province of China)" ~ 158,
      TRUE ~ m49_code
    )
  )

fpi_gdp2 <- fpi_gdp |>
  left_join(
    crosswalk |>
      select(country_code, m49_code, location_id),
    by = c("country_code", "m49_code")
  )

fpi_gdp2 |>
  filter(is.na(location_id)) |>
  distinct(country_or_area)

covariates <- full_join(
  fpi_gdp2,
  shock_war |>
    select(location_id, year, shock, war_terror),
  by = c("location_id", "year")
)

covariates <- covariates |>
  left_join(
    crosswalk |>
      select(location_id, gbd_location_name, country_code, m49_code),
    by = "location_id",
    suffix = c("", ".cw")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    country = coalesce(country_or_area, gbd_location_name),
    country_code = coalesce(country_code, country_code.cw),
    m49_code = coalesce(m49_code, m49_code.cw)
  ) |>
  select(-ends_with(".cw")) |>
  rename(gbd_location_id = location_id) |> 
  mutate(
    country = if_else(is.na(country), country.y, country)) |> 
  select(country, country.x:country.y, gbd_location_name, country_code, m49_code, gbd_location_id, everything()) |> 
  arrange(country, year) |> 
  group_by(m49_code) |>
  fill(country.x, .direction = "downup") |>
  fill(country_or_area, .direction = "downup") |>
  fill(country.y, .direction = "downup") |>
  ungroup()

# Should only be territories with no GBD location
covariates |>
  filter(is.na(gbd_location_id)) |>
  distinct(country) |> print(n = 50)

# Should only be Taiwan, Cook Islands, Nauru, Niue, Tokelau
covariates |>
  filter(
    is.na(country_code),
    !is.na(gbd_location_id)
  ) |>
  distinct(gbd_location_id, gbd_location_name)

# Should be zero rows
covariates |>
  filter(!is.na(gbd_location_id)) |>
  count(gbd_location_id, year) |>
  filter(n > 1)

write_csv(covariates, "FPI_GDP_IHMESHOCK.csv")
```



# Adding WPP demographic indicators and SDI

Both files are merged onto `covariates` (the FPI/GDP/IHME shock data created above), so the country universe stays the same. WPP is keyed on M49 code (`LocID`, which agrees with `m49_code` for every ISO3 shared between the files) and SDI is keyed on the GBD `location_id`.

## WPP 2024 demographic indicators

```{r}
wpp <- read_csv("WPP2024_Demographic_Country_Indicators_Medium.csv") |>
  filter(
    LocTypeName == "Country/Area",
    year <= max(covariates$year, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  select(-c(SortOrder, Notes, ISO2_code, SDMX_code, LocTypeID, LocTypeName,
            ParentID, VarID, Variant)) |>
  rename(
    m49_code = LocID,
    wpp_location = Location
  )

# Should be zero rows (no duplicate keys)
wpp |> count(m49_code, year) |> filter(n > 1)

# WPP countries/areas with no match in the FPI/GDP/IHME data. These are mostly
# small territories (and Taiwan) and will be dropped.
wpp |>
  anti_join(covariates, by = "m49_code") |>
  distinct(ISO3_code, wpp_location) |>
  print(n = 50)

# Covariate rows that cannot be matched because they have no M49 code
covariates |>
  filter(is.na(m49_code)) |>
  distinct(country, gbd_location_id)
```

```{r}
covariates_wpp <- covariates |>
  left_join(wpp, by = c("m49_code", "year"))

# Should agree wherever both are present
covariates_wpp |>
  filter(!is.na(ISO3_code), !is.na(country_code), ISO3_code != country_code) |>
  distinct(country, country_code, ISO3_code)

# Countries (with GBD ids) that never picked up WPP data
covariates_wpp |>
  group_by(country, m49_code, gbd_location_id) |>
  filter(all(is.na(TPopulation1July))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  distinct(country, m49_code, gbd_location_id)

covariates_wpp <- covariates_wpp |>
  select(-c(ISO3_code, wpp_location))
```

## SDI

SDI covers 1950-2023, so 2024-2026 will be missing after the merge.

```{r}
sdi <- read_csv("sdi_gbd_2023.csv") |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(
    gbd_location_id = location_id,
    sdi_location = location
  )

# Should be zero rows (no duplicate keys)
sdi |> count(gbd_location_id, year) |> filter(n > 1)

# SDI locations not in the covariate data (expected: Taiwan)
sdi |>
  anti_join(covariates_wpp, by = "gbd_location_id") |>
  distinct(gbd_location_id, sdi_location)

covariates_all <- covariates_wpp |>
  left_join(sdi, by = c("gbd_location_id", "year"))

# Covariate countries with a GBD id but no SDI (should be none)
covariates_all |>
  filter(!is.na(gbd_location_id)) |>
  group_by(gbd_location_id, country) |>
  filter(all(is.na(sdi))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  distinct(gbd_location_id, country)

# Should be zero rows: the merges must not add or duplicate rows
nrow(covariates_all) - nrow(covariates)
covariates_all |>
  filter(!is.na(gbd_location_id)) |>
  count(gbd_location_id, year) |>
  filter(n > 1)

covariates_all <- covariates_all |>
  select(-sdi_location)
```
